eps.t: My First Time in a While
eps.o: J.D. enlists Turk and Elliot to help with Dr. Cox's care; Elliot finds an unexpected burst of confidence years in the making.
J.D. attempts an insurance workaround, creating tension with his new mentee; Elliot tries to guide Tosh's specialty choices; Turk flexes his own skills as a mentor.
J.D. reintroduces an old flame into Elliot's life, as his new relationship continues to blossom; Turk tries a new approach to keeping the spark alive at home.
After uncovering a costly mistake made by Turk, J.D. must decide whether to report him or let it slide; Elliot grows her responsibilities at Sacred Heart by leading a new initiative.
Turk is determined to have a fun birthday with J.D. and Elliot. Meanwhile, the interns are challenged during the night shift
This Halloween, J.D. helps a former colleague with a difficult patient, Elliot seeks support for her new clinic and Turk faces his family's growing pains.
J.D. and Elliot reconnect while managing a difficult parenting conversation; the interns grapple with work-life balance.
When an overflowing ER sparks chaos within the hospital, J.D. is surprised to learn the reason why. Meanwhile, Turk mentors Dashana in her personal life.
